findings.excerpt: title: "C_2 free-product C_2 is the infinite dihedral group, and the product of its generators has infinite order"
findings.symptom: The title prints both C_2 occurrences with literal underscores. The same free-product notation is typeset in the Example body.
findings.suggested_repair: Format the group notation in the title with inline math, for example "$C_2 * C_2$ is the infinite dihedral group" or use Unicode subscripts.
